relatedEntities.name: 4-Aminophenol (residual)
relatedEntities.notes: Critical related substance / genotox control theme

properties.solubility: Sparingly soluble in water; soluble in alcohols

hazardStatements: H302 Harmful if swallowed (confirm current SDS)
hazards.notes: Intermediate p-aminophenol and nitroaromatic precursors carry stronger toxicity and sensitization concerns than the finished API.

overview: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) is typically manufactured by selective acetylation of 4-aminophenol, itself obtained from nitrobenzene-based sequences or other industrial precursor routes. High-volume API plants emphasize impurity control (including genotoxic impurity strategies where applicable), color bodies, and consistent crystallinity for downstream formulation.
manufacturingSummary: Batch or continuous acetylation of 4-aminophenol with acetic anhydride or acetic acid packages; crystallization; drying. Upstream 4-aminophenol supply may be captively integrated or purchased.

environmentBaseline.atmosphere: N2 blanketing for anhydride transfers recommended
environmentBaseline.atexZone: Classify solvent areas per site standards

ehsHighlights: Acetic anhydride corrosion and exotherm on quench
API dust explosion risk assessment for finishing

routes.name: 4-Aminophenol acetylation (standard industrial)
routes.summary: Selective N-acetylation of 4-aminophenol yields paracetamol. Conditions are tuned to minimize O-acetylation and over-reaction impurities, followed by crystallization to pharma grade.
disadvantages: Impurity inheritance from upstream nitro chemistry
routes.overallYieldTypical: High for final acetylation (typically >90% with good control)

steps.title: N-Acetylation
steps.description: Charge 4-aminophenol and process solvent. Add acetic anhydride under temperature control. Hold to conversion. Optional base/buffer strategies exist in literature variants.
steps.mechanismNotes: The more nucleophilic aromatic amine attacks acetic anhydride to form the acetamide. Phenol O-acetylation is a competing path under some conditions; selectivity is controlled by stoichiometry, medium, and temperature.

cqaTargets: Conversion and impurity profile within gates

steps.scaleNotes: Exotherm and mixing time at scale can shift impurity profile—map heat release early.

steps.title: Crystallization and isolation
steps.description: Crystallize paracetamol, wash to remove acetic residues and colored impurities, dry to LOD target. Optional charcoal treatment in some packages.

routes.isolation: Centrifuge or filter; aqueous/organic washes per package; vacuum dry.

scaleUp.labToKilo: Glass-lined 50–500 L with controlled anhydride feed.
scaleUp.kiloToPilot: Define crystallization seed and cooling ramps; charcoal filtration flux if used.
scaleUp.pilotToCommercial: Integrate with upstream 4-AP manufacture or dual-source qualification.
scaleUp.greenChemistryNotes: Recover acetic acid; evaluate acetic acid acetylation packages that reduce anhydride inventory.

disclaimer: Not a validated GMP procedure. Confirm all conditions against site process validation and regulatory filings.
